title: NumericalJacobianODE1RHS
author: JG
description: add case for duplicated ODE1 coordinates if connector has two markers for the same object, same as ltgODE2numDiff
releaseNotes: the numerical Jacobian of ODE1 equations differentiates an ODE1 coordinate that an object addresses twice only once; before, its column was added twice, which slowed Newton's convergence
